rewrites.//: SPA fallback for app routes only. It must never match a real asset path: if it does and the file is momentarily missing (mid-deploy, say), the edge answers a .js request with index.html — and the immutable header below then pins that HTML in every visitor's browser cache for a year, leaving a blank page. Anything under _expo/ or assets/, and anything with a file extension, is excluded so a missing asset 404s instead.

headers.//: The shell is the only thing that names the current bundle, so it has to be revalidated on every load.
